description: Lists the SIOs (serial I/O boards) attached to one Mercury panel (wraps NBAPI GetSios). There is no unfiltered "all SIOs" listing — MERCURYKEY is required; the response carries a NEXTKEY pagination cursor.

MERCURYKEY.description: Required. The Mercury panel key whose SIOs should be listed. Use get_mercury_panels to discover keys.

name: get_sios
